supplier_cost_note: IndiaMART seller Happy Grumpy (New Delhi) lists 'Brown Mens Cork Wallet' at Rs 399/piece; the same seller lists Cork Wallet Rs 199/piece (style unclear, may be a card holder), Cork Zipper Wallet Rs 299/piece and Brown Cork Ladies Wallet Rs 499/piece. MOQ not stated (WebSearch snippets seen 2026-11-22, page not opened). Other IndiaMART snippets the same day: 'Cork Mens Wallets' Rs 449/piece (seller not identified, men's wallet category) and a cork leather bifold Rs 350/piece (seller not identified, bi-fold wallet category). Assumed excl. GST; manufacturer status, single-piece drop-ship, gift box and dispatch SLA NOT confirmed. Rs 399 is 30.7% of Rs 1,299, above the ~27% guide. 2026-11-27 re-check (WebSearch snippets): second Indian cork-goods maker found. Anchor Cork Private Limited (IndiaMART; snippet says Daman, operating since 1993, manufacturer/exporter of cork products, 51-100 employees) lists a cork passport folder at Rs 950/piece, a cork men's wallet at Rs 1,000/piece and a cork men's keychain wallet at Rs 250/piece (https://m.indiamart.com/anchorcork/tableware-trivets.html; https://m.indiamart.com/anchorcork/testimonial.html). MOQ, dimensions and material backing were not shown. Pragyatt Enterprise, Jaipur (est. 2021) lists cork men's wallets but no price was visible (https://m.indiamart.com/pragyatt-enterprise). Happy Grumpy also lists 'Printed Cork Vegan Leather Fabric' at Rs 1,250/metre (https://m.indiamart.com/happygrumpy/ladies-wallet.html). That shows the seller handles printed cork-look material, so its low-priced 'cork' items could be printed rather than real cork sheet (unconfirmed). The Anchor Cork men's wallet at Rs 1,000/piece is not usable at the Rs 1,299 price (77% of price). supplier_cost is left at Rs 399.

risks: Supplier cost Rs 399 is 30.7% of Rs 1,299, above the ~27% guide; likely BELOW_TARGET unless the Rs 350 bifold seller is identified and confirmed
No marketplace (Amazon.in/Flipkart/Meesho) price found. Rs 1,299 is supported only by D2C eco stores, so marketplace shoppers may compare it with Rs 300-500 PU or leather wallets
Supplier in New Delhi, so this is website-only under docs/05 (no APOB on the Odisha GSTIN); no Odisha cork supplier found
Material claims ('natural cork', 'vegan', 'leather-free') need supplier evidence under require_evidence_for_claims; cork fabric is usually laminated on a PU or textile backing
Wallet build quality (stitching, edge peeling) varies, which carries a return/dispute risk; get a sample first
Supplier photos need permission; avoid brand look-alikes
GST/HSN to be confirmed by the CA (4202 wallets vs 4504 agglomerated cork articles); 18% used as the conservative figure

2026-11-27: real cork is still unconfirmed for the Happy Grumpy items. The established cork maker Anchor Cork lists its equivalents at about 2.5-4x Happy Grumpy's prices (wallet Rs 1,000, passport folder Rs 950), and Happy Grumpy also sells printed cork-look fabric. Together these raise the chance that the cheap items are printed or PU-backed. The only Indian maker with stated real-cork construction is Clan Earth, Kolkata: its Brown Living listings say cork on a cotton backing, not PU (https://brownliving.in/products/kiwi-printed-cork-wallet). No Clan Earth wholesale price was found. Anchor Cork's prices would fail margin at the current selling price, so supplier_cost is unchanged.

review.notes: No hard-rule breach and no mass-marketplace cork bifold found at or below Rs 600 (Amazon.in, Flipkart and Meesho searches on 2026-11-22 surfaced no cork wallet; Meesho men's wallets are PU/leather at Rs 103-190), and Rs 1,299 sits below D2C cork bifolds at Rs 1,450-1,699, so margin passes on Shopify only (42.9% at Rs 399 cost, Delhi supplier). But the material is unverified: no listing confirms real cork sheet versus PU printed to look like cork, which matters because 'natural cork/vegan' claims need evidence; also no MOQ, single-piece drop-ship or gift box confirmed. Needed before approve: written supplier quote (MOQ, drop-ship, GST invoice), material spec or test evidence for cork content and backing, and a physical sample to check edge sealing and stitching.

No systematic peeling data found; sample must be checked for edge sealing, slot stitching and backing delamination.
